hero.source: FORT SCAMMON, CHARLESTON, KANAWHA COUNTY, WV
hero.description:
BUILT BY UNION SOLDIERS IN 1863 HIGH ABOVE CHARLESTON AND THE KANAWHA RIVER.  IN 1862 CONFEDERATE TROOPS FIRED FROM THIS SITE ONTO CHARLESTON.  FUTURE PRESIDENTS HAYES AND MCKINLEY SERVED HERE  





This is an image of a place or building that is listed on the National Register of Historic Places in the United States of America. Its reference number is 76001939 (Wikidata).
